title: sqlite3mc 2.3.2 → 2.3.5 bump (SQLite 3.51.3 → 3.53.2)
impact: Satisfies exp 090's revisit trigger (SQLite `.2`+ point release with sqlite3mc tracking it); tests stay green including embedded-NUL + Unicode bind regression suite; release-suite single-pass A/Bs swing between 19/18/124 and 30/2/129 — Concurrent Reads 8× is the only metric that flags consistently across reruns (+~20% on a sub-ms metric) and is the focus of the soak window; FP-rounding hazard skipped because resqlite never serialises REAL via `sqlite3_column_text`
